AMZ100-252230-
417 AM EST Wed Nov 25 2026

.Synopsis for Eastern North Carolina coastal waters...
A strong area of low pressure is forecast to develop along the 
southeast coast and impact area waters today with widespread 
Gales and Storm conditions expected over and near the Gulf Stream 
waters, with the worst conditions Wednesday night. High seas will
linger through the rest of the work week with improving 
conditions this weekend.
